67: Your score in the Pokéathlon\nturn into Athlete Points, and you can\ftrade 'em for prizes.\rEven if you finish dead last,\nyour score still count!
68: “Hurdle Dash”\rMad Hurdles waitin' on your homies!\nBe faster and sharper than\feverybody else! Jump the Hurdles\fand go for number one!
69: “Pennant Capture”\rPennants is hidden on the beach.\nFight over 'em and come back with as\fmany Pennants as you can!
70: “Circle Push”\rTime to show off your\nhomie's Power!\fPush 'em out and stay in the Circle!
71: “Block Smash”\rA mountain of Blocks waitin' on\nyour homies!\fUse that Power to smash 'em all!
72: “Disc Catch”\rDiscs get thrown at you. Jump and\ncatch 'em in the air!\rDon't get boxed in by the others.\nCatch as many as you can!
73: “Lamp Jump”\rYou never know how high you gon'\nbounce! Use your homie's Jump\fand Skill to score!
74: “Relay Run”\rKeep runnin' till you can't run\nno more! Three homies work together\fto get the W!
75: “Ring Drop”\rHomies tackle! Push past your Stamina\nlimit and stay in the Ring!
76: “Snow Throw”\rOn a field that's colder than cold,\nMILLIONS of Snowballs waitin'!\rAim and throw!\nTime it right to show your skill!
77: “Goal Roll”\rPut your whole heart into hittin' the\nball! Attack! Defend your Goal!\rAim for the other Goals!\nWho gon' get the W?
78: Work with your homies. Believe in 'em,\nand help 'em believe in you!\fBelieve in their potential.\fLet the friendship lead\nyour team to the W!\rThe Pokéathlon always with you!
79: Charge up with friendship!\nGive Aprijuice to your homies!
